latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the MindLog skill for OpenClaw.

- Enables daily journal prompts and weekly pattern analysis via Telegram.
- Guides users through setup by collecting required API key, Telegram bot token, and chat ID.
- Verifies API and Telegram connectivity before activating scheduling.
- Supports flexible scheduling using either cron jobs or heartbeat polling.
- Automates daily prompting, reply capture, and weekly analysis/report delivery.
- Robust error handling and clear user notifications throughout setup and operation.
